gaps: Outsourcing I refers to a book excerpt on Blackboard ('see BB'). It is not in the folder, so outsourcing content comes only from the slides.
Lecture 6 (Spaceship game) is a classroom simulation with rules only. There is almost no theory to ask about.

The practice test came as five screenshots; its right answers are the ones marked in them. Three answers are not stated in one sentence on the slides (questions 9, 12 and 13), so those questions are flagged.

The two SAFe pictures (essential and full configuration) hold more detail than the slide text. The essential picture is covered at the level of its headings (Lean-Agile leadership, built-in quality, continuous delivery, DevOps); the full configuration picture is not.
The BCG matrix and Business Model Canvas slides are pictures with a title only, without any explanation. They are covered at the level of what the pictures show.
Not in the folder: the Debating Best Practices document, the audit report example structure ('see BS'), and any material for week 45 (PI Planning preparation).
The lectures link to YouTube videos. Their content is not available, so nothing from them is covered.

simulation.note: The course plan (Lecture 1) says this is a multiple-choice theory exam, but not how many questions, how long it lasts or what the pass mark is. The professor's practice test has 20 questions, so 20 questions in 30 minutes is a practice setup of your own (the practice test shows no time). Change the numbers in the "simulation" block of exam.json.
